notes: All future figures are research budgets, not company commitments. Margins include 0.5% sales of recurring cash policy support; subtract noncash grant amortisation and exclude financial-asset income. R&D stays expensed.

Parent and funding buckets are estimated standalone cash allocations reconciled to consolidated common-equity cash, not Q3 audited entity accounts. Parent opening cash is lower than H1 disclosed cash plus liquid investments. Overseas includes Hong Kong funding/support operations; no subsidiary dividend funds first five years.

Mother's statutory reserve already exceeds half registered capital; no repeated 10% reserve appropriation. Domestic subsidiaries retain 10% positive profits indefinitely because opening legal reserves are not established. Overseas must first recover assumed accumulated loss; no opening Hong Kong realised surplus is distributed.

Only actual common-owner liquid cash is included. Repay all small debt/lease balance at opening as a budget simplification. Government special payable is not debt: H1 note 48 identifies government grant; its amortisation is excluded from cash earnings and it is not repaid again.

Opening operating fixed capital includes fixed assets, construction, intangibles, long-term prepaid/operating assets. No separate subtraction for already-paid construction. Capital commitments are included within forecast cash capex, not added twice.

Remaining minimum buyback is budgeted at the announced ceiling, with fees. Its shares and purchased shares are cancelled in Y1; all old employee treasury shares are assumed reissued for no proceeds. H-share issuance is not assumed completed.
